600: Open the mail window to follow the tutorial
601: Hi!§We are going to guide you through the basic principles of the game. Every message will give you a mission and explain how to complete it. Once the mission has been completed a new message will give you a new one.§§Mission: Create a Level 1 Research position.§§Info:§To create a Level 1 workstation, you need to buy a Level 1 Lab-bench and hire a Level 1 Researcher. A Level 1 Research position allows you to research Level 1 components.§§Step 1:§Go to the Lab (or hit F8) and click on one of the broken lab-benches.§§Step 2:§Choose a Level 1 Lab-bench in under the Materials tab at the bottom center of the screen, then validate your purchase by clicking on Buy.§§Step 3:§Click on the Personnel tab. Select a Level 1 Researcher in the list of CVs, then click on Hire.§§Step 4:§To continue, click on the message Tutorial: The components....
602: Well done! You have created a Level 1 Research position.§§Mission:§Research all the basic components for the latrine.§§Info:§A product is the assembly of several components. Before you can start manufacturing, you have to research the basic components for your product. The latrines, for example, are made up of three components:§- 'Seat'§- 'Flush'§- 'Accessory'.§§Step 1:§Click on the Action tab for the Researcher. Select the visible component and then click on Start Research. The component being researched is displayed on the board on the Lab-bench and a radar shows you the advancement of the research. Wait for the research to finish, when a message will tell inform you that the component has been researched.§§Step 2:§Still in the Researchers Action tab, change the Category of Component by clicking on the green buttons, and research the other two basic components. Remember to wait for one component to be researched before starting the next one.
603: Congratulations! You have successfully researched the three basic components for the latrine! §§Mission:§Research three components with a higher design quality.§§Info:§Each category of component has two technology trees: a technical one, reading from left to right, and a design one, reading from top to bottom. Dont forget that the level of the workstation (Lab-bench and Researcher) has to correspond to the level of the component that you want to research. To research some components you will also need a lab machine or another component. If this is the case, your Researcher will inform you. You can see the complete technology trees in the manual.§§NB:§If you complete the research for a particular component before your competitors you will earn royalties and a circle the color of your logo (red) will appear on the label. As soon as a second player has completed this research, the patent falls into the public domain and you will no longer receive royalties. The circle becomes white.§§Step 1:§In each of the three categories of component, research the component with the best design. It will be below the one you have just researched. Remember that you cant start researching a component in the second column because your workstation does not have a high enough level.
604: Info:§When you hire a new employee, their description indicates their potential (max. 3, for example). This means that they can reach Level 3 after Level Training, available for each employee once you have hired a Human Resources Manager.§§Mission:§The first part of the tutorial is finshed. Click on OK below to go back to the tutorial menu and the next chapter.

626: Mission:§Make 1,000 latrines from the following components:§-Barber-inspired adjustable pedal seat§-Flush facility with chemical dose§-Toilet roll in a choice of perfumes.§§Info:§Your production line is composed of an Assembly Machine (the big yellow machine) to assemble the components, and Manufacturing Machines which make your components. To start production, all of these workstations need to be operational.§§Step 1:§Go to Production (or hit F5), and click on the control panel for the Assembly Machine. Buy a control panel and hire a Supervisor to make a Level 1 workstation.§§Step 2:§For each of the three categories of component, click on the broken machine and make a Level 1 workstation. Then click on the Action tab, choose the required component and validate. The selected component is then displayed on the blackboard next to the Assembly Machine.§§Step 3:§Your production line is now operational. Click on the Action tab for the Assembly workstation and set the yield on the gauge. The number of units produced is shown on the Indicators panel (F1, to come back to this panel: F4).§§Step 4:§Wait to have a stock of 1,000 units.
627: Info:§If the yield is too high, the machines will wear out and break down. As soon as a machine breaks down, production stops. You can then either buy a new machine or repair the old one. Click in the Action tab for the technician whose machine is broken and select the monkey wrench.§§NB:§For the purposes of the tutorial, your products are not sold on the market. Normally only the production surplus is stocked. Avoid overproduction by checking your stock in the Indicators panel.§As soon as you change one of your products components, the stock that you have of the old product is thrown away if you have not asked your Sales Manager to sell it off (Level 2 action). When the stock has been sold off, it will pay for the components.§§Mission:§The second part of the tutorial is finished. Click on OK to go back to the Tutorial menu.

651: Mission:§Reach a sales peak of 200 latrines.§§Info:§To sell your products you need to adjust certain parameters : price, advertising, product image, and company reputation. All these parameters are displayed in the Indicators panel (F1). Remember to watch your cash level and trade balance in the top tool bar because some actions are expensive...§§Step 1:§Go to the Indicators panel (F1) and set your margin at 40.§Restart production at 100 units.§§Step 2:§Price: go to Marketing (F7) and hire a Sales Manager. He will start work immediately. Under his Action tab, set the Negotiate gauge so that he spends most of his time negotiating the distributors margin.§§Step 3:§Advertising: go to the Indicators panel (F1) and set the adverstising budgets to 50,000 each. Now hire a Publicity Officer (next to the Sales Manager), who will immediately start optimizing your advertising budgets.§§Step 4 (optional):§Product image: your Sales Manager will spend his time working on negotiation and product positioning. You decide where he should spend more time. You can also hire an airship (Publicity Officer Level 2) or discreetly Bribe the distributor (Sales Manager Level 3)§§Step 5 (optional):§Reputation: you can buy buildings (on the building sign next to each building), get the Lunar Ad (Publicity Officer Level 3) or launch rumors about your competitors (Lawyer Level 2).§§Step 6:§Gradually increase your production to 200 units and watch the market catch you up.
652: Your Marketing strategy is in place. Now lets look at how youre going to fine-tune it for specific consumers.§§Mission:§Sell 150 latrines to emotives.§§Info:§There are two types of consumer, each of whom has different shopping criteria:§-Techies (represented by apartment blocks) are particularly sensitive to the technics of the finished product, reputation, and advertising in the specialist press.§-Emotives (represented by maisonettes) like the image of a product, TV advertising, the design of a product and the price.§§Step 1:§In the Indicators panel, increase the advertising budget for emotives to 250,000, and set your Publicity Officers TV advertising gauge halfway.§§Step 2:§Reduce your margin to 20.§§Step 3:§If you havent done so already, bring your Publicity Officers workstation to Level 2. To do this, buy a Level 2 desk, fire your Publicity Officer, and hire a Level 2 one. Then launch the Airship action.§§NB:§To understand more about how an employee shares their time between different actions, consult the manual.§§Step 4:§Once the airship action is finished, gradually increase your sales until you reach your objective.

1101: The markets were buoyant today after several major firms reported very encouraging results for 3Q, pushing the index up 4.2%. Market-watchers were cautiously optimistic about the state of the economy.
1102: The market greeted the news of an ambitious government reform program, unveiled today, with relief. At close, the index was up fourteen points from yesterday, calming traders' fears of a slump.
1103: The bankruptcy of a major firm caused near panic among investors today, and some stocks fell by as much as 20%. Adding to the turmoil is the speculation that the President of the Central Bank may resign.
1104: Two major firms have just announced extensive redundancy programs. A total of 14,000 jobs are to be axed as companies react to the market slowdown.
1105: Better-than-expected results reported by several major tech stocks have given a much-needed boost to the flagging market, pushing the index up 3.5%.
1106: Nervous markets were reassured today by important gains on the healthcare and energy sectors. This encouraging note pushed the index up 3.6%.
1107: The President of the Central Bank has announced his resignation, further depressing the markets and fuelling speculation that a serious financial crisis may now be inevitable.
1108: Signs that inflation may be edging up have prompted analysts' fears of an interest rate hike. This depressed an already sluggish market still further today. The index fell 2.9%.
1109: A major firm reported better-than-expected annual earnings figures today. The market rallied at the news and the index closed up 3.2%.
1110: The Central Bank has announced a surprise cut in interest rates. The cut, of 0.25%, seems to be a reaction to signs of a general economic slowdown.
1111: Generalizing a trend hitherto confined to the banking and electronics sectors, major firms issued profit warnings today. This has added to fears of a recession.
1112: As expected, the Central Bank announced a rise in interest rates today. Investors were disappointed by the size of the hike, at 0.75%, and this was reflected in the 3.1% fall in the index.
